value.hook: When a send succeeds but its correlated request remains unanswered, or reviewing receipt warnings
value.title: Answer diagnostics must distinguish eligibility from persistence failure

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Review receipt diagnostics against both eligibility failures and persistence failures. A boolean answer_by_reply false covers not-holder/not-delivered/already-answered as well as a failed audit/store write. A subsequent stored-state read must handle Delivered plus unanswered explicitly, not infer that every false means not delivered. In #223 at 881a3f568e6c078d5f642c3574ddc9813902838f, http/mod.rs unanswered falls through to "is delivered, not delivered" after such a failure. C34 follow-up N223-001 is nonblocking; no additional review round requested.

Review receipts are in the canonical output writer: #222 ac95e53 PASS (997833bcaa2ca3d787dc9ccbfde213ea501580f0), #219 31bf8fb PASS (956c801e382b467bd4936e4184f99e59bc50bed4), #223 881a3f5 PASS-WITH-NOTES (1087df3194ecdc2ce1edd117c749cc86acaeea2b). Each answers its inherited request. #224 4ad1323 is the config-only review completed in the same batch; use its canonical output for the final receipt. No product edits or daemon/lifecycle operations.

Magic wand: a dependency-free review-proof command that takes a PR, verifies its final head, locates the successful Rust job's exact artifact ID and prints requested test names/results from that artifact. Today this requires separate gh job-log, artifact-download and XML parsing steps. Never select JUnit by name alone when retries exist.

Difficulty: node_modules-less detached trees are expected under C25, but harness checks tries ambient npm tools anyway. The quick gate produced seven failures, including an incompatible global Biome instead of a clear dependency-unavailable result. The full gate was cancelled after the already-known tooling failures to avoid unnecessary shared-machine work. A deps-readiness sensor should mark those TS sensors UNAVAILABLE while still running dependency-free checks and pointing reviewers at exact-head CI. This is a suggested encoding, not an implemented product change.
